Define a theme

bb_theme.Rd

A theme holds the colour palette, the text roles components draw with, and the status palette used by [bb_status()]. Set it once with [bb_set_theme()], or attach it to a [page_template()].

Usage

bb_theme(
  font = "sans",
  base_size = 9,
  colors = list(),
  text = list(),
  status = c(yes = "#2F7D55", no = "#C2412F", unknown = "#9AA1AA")
)

Arguments

font

Default font family. With systemfonts installed, weights such as 600 resolve to the matching installed face (see [text_style()]).

base_size

Body font size in points.

colors

Named list of colours that override or extend the palette.

text

Named list of [text_style()] objects that override or extend the text roles. Fields left `NULL` keep the role default.

status

Named colours for `yes`, `no` and `unknown`.

Value

A `bb_theme` object.

Details

**Colours.** Every colour argument in bodybuildr accepts either an R colour or the name of a theme colour, for example `"muted"` or `"rule_light"`. Defaults: `primary`, `accent`, `ink`, `text2`, `muted`, `faint`, `rule_strong`, `rule_light`, `rule_faint`, `panel`, `panel_alt`, `on_primary`, `on_primary_muted`. Add your own names freely.

**Text roles.** Components take `style = NULL` and fall back to a role: `body`, `table_body`, `note`, `small`, `subheading`, `section`, `refs`, `title`, `subtitle`, `running`, `running_right`, `table_header`, `legend`, `footer`, `status_label`, `placeholder`. Pass a role name as `style` anywhere (`bb_text(x, style = "note")`), override a role through `text`, or add new roles.

Default sizes follow a 12px = 9pt body scale; `base_size` scales them all.

Examples

th <- bb_theme(font = "sans", colors = list(primary = "#123456"),
               text = list(note = text_style(size = 8)))
th$colors$primary
#> [1] "#123456"
